subject: Altum onboarding — MSA redline review & demo coordination
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Ortiz <natalie.ortiz@altum.io>; James Ng <james.ng@lawbridge.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Altum onboarding — MSA redline review & demo coordination

Hi Natalie / James —

Thanks for starting the redline pass. To make progress next week I propose we split the session into two short blocks: 30 minutes with Legal to walk major MSA redlines, then a 45-minute product demo focused on our deployment/playbook and observability (so your SREs and procurement can see latency/cost tooling).

Do any of these windows work on your side (PT):
- Tue 2026-10-06, 10:00–11:15 PT (legal + demo back-to-back)
- Wed 2026-10-07, 14:00–15:15 PT (legal + demo)
- Thu 2026-10-08, 09:00–10:15 PT (split: legal first, demo later)

I’ve attached a short demo deck and will come prepared with a short runbook and the MSA comparison sheet. Kimberly — can you lead the legal review (we’ll put redline highlights in the first call)? Lauren — can you open the demo and run through the onboarding checklist?

Attachments: demo-deck-v1.pptx (slide deck), internal runbook (link inbody)

Thanks — looking forward to locking a slot.

Jordan Blake
Principal Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.com]

Subject: Re: Altum onboarding — MSA redline review & demo coordination

Thanks Jordan — appreciate the split approach. We’re excited to move forward but have a calendar crunch early next week (end of quarter here).

Best windows for our team are:
- Wed 2026-10-07, 15:00–16:00 PT (preferred)
- Thu 2026-10-08, 10:00–11:00 PT (backup)

I’m attaching our annotated MSA PDF (Altum_MSA_v2_redlines.pdf) — the legal team highlighted a few clauses they’d like to flag for discussion (data retention, audit rights, and subprocessor flowdown). James (our outside counsel) will join the legal block.

If Wednesday 15:00 PT works, we can keep the session tight: 25–30 minutes for legal, then a 40-minute demo if you can stay on.

Thanks,

Subject: Fwd: Altum onboarding — MSA redline review & demo coordination

Jordan / Lauren — quick internal note:

I reviewed Altum_MSA_v2_redlines.pdf and flagged the three items Natalie called out plus standard GDPR locality language. I can do a 25–30 minute redline run on Wed 2026-10-07 at 15:00 PT. If we need extra time for the data-retention thread I recommend we:

1) Keep the first meeting strictly to clause triage (identify blockers, propose short-term language to avoid delays).
2) Schedule a follow-up legal deep-dive with James if we can’t reach language in 30 min.
3) Lauren — can you prepare the onboarding checklist and an example observability dashboard screenshot to help procurement evaluate the controls quickly?

I’ll prepare a 1-page summary of proposed language tweaks and a risk level (low/medium/high) per clause prior to Wed.

—Kimberly

Agenda (high level):
- 15:00–15:30 PT: Legal triage — Kimberly + James lead. Goal: agree on blocking items and decide immediate temporary language or follow-up cadence.
- 15:35–16:15 PT: Demo & onboarding walkthrough — Lauren will show the onboarding checklist, quick deploy runbook, and the observability dashboard.

Action items before Wed:
- Kimberly: one-page proposed tweaks + risk matrix (shared to meeting notes)
- Lauren: screen-ready demo deck + dashboard screenshot (attached)
- Natalie / James: confirm attendees and any additional docs to surface

I’ve attached the demo deck (demo-deck-v1.pptx) and added the HubSpot deal link and DocuSign placeholder to the meeting notes. If any timing/attendees change, reply-all and we’ll adjust.
